final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(*) as race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09' GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), step2 AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_count) as avg_count FROM step1 GROUP BY country) SELECT s1.circuitId, s1.country, s1.race_count, CAST(s1.race_count AS REAL) / s2.avg_count as ratio FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.country = s2.country ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
